mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling increased housing activity, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 60 trading days due to the housing market's impact on the broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with HOUST above its 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL, when narrowing, indicates a more accommodative monetary policy stance relative to inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 5%, signaling a strong labor market, boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE below 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when RSAFS increases by > 5% over 1 month and HOUST is above its 3-month moving average, signaling robust demand and housing activity, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
